paragraphs.text: Martha Wells (born 1964) is an American writer of speculative fiction . She has published several fantasy novels, young adult novels, media tie-ins, multiple short stories, and nonfiction essays on fantasy and science fiction subjects.

Wells was hired as the head writer for twelve episodes behind Magic: The Gathering ’s 78th expansion, Dominaria . As leader of Magic’s story team , she was driving the fiction and building the lore around the expansion, which marked not only the game's 25th anniversary but also a major event in the Magic franchise.
